reply.text: I can't give you a salt amount, and that one's for a sports dietitian or your doctor, especially with heat involved, since the right number depends on your health and how much you sweat. What I can say as your coach: don't try a new salt strategy for the first time on race day. Practise your fueling and hydration on your long runs in warm conditions, so you know how your body handles it before the start line. If you tell me your race date and what your long runs look like right now, I can help you plan the training side of that build.
